# AgentForge operations

<!-- Generated by `agentforge schema`; do not edit by hand. -->

Every request is one JSON line. Full argument and result schemas: `protocol.schema.json` (or `discover` with `{"operation": "<name>"}`).

| Operation | Roles | Mutates | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `discover` | author, player | no | Describe the engine: game rules, conventions, limits, the operations this session may call (with examples) and error codes. Pass `operation` for one operation's full schemas. |
| `session.status` | author, player | no | Report this session's role, revision, open project, active episode and snapshots. |
| `project.create` | author | yes | Open a new, empty in-memory project (replacing any open project; unsaved changes are discarded). |
| `project.load` | author | yes | Open a project file. Invalid or incompatible files are rejected without changing the session. |
| `project.save` | author | no | Write the open project to a file atomically (temporary file, fsync, rename). |
| `scene.create` | author | yes | Create a scene from an ASCII layout or from width/height, with optional rules. |
| `scene.get` | author | no | Return a scene with every entity (including labels), its rules, ASCII view and digest. |
| `scene.validate` | author | no | Check completeness (player, exit) and gameplay problems (unsolvable, too slow for max_ticks, unusable keys or doors). |
| `scene.apply_batch` | author | yes | Apply create/update/remove/update_rules edits atomically: all succeed, or the scene and revision stay unchanged and the failing edit index is reported. |
| `scene.update_rules` | author | yes | Change rule parameters (max_ticks, win_condition) of a scene. |
| `scene.render` | author | no | Render a scene as SVG (entity ids labelled) or ASCII, inline or to a file. For human inspection; no GUI needed. |
| `entity.create` | author | yes | Create one entity; the engine assigns its id. |
| `entity.get` | author | no | Return one entity, including its authoring label. |
| `entity.update` | author | yes | Change an entity's kind, position and/or label (empty label clears it). |
| `entity.remove` | author | yes | Remove an entity. Its id is never reused. |
| `analysis.reachability` | author | no | Answer whether a target (default: the win condition) is reachable from a start (default: the player spawn), separately for walls only (geometric) and under the full rules (gameplay); when it is not, list the blockers and verified single-removal repairs. |
| `episode.start` | author, player | no | Start a new episode (replacing the active one) on a frozen copy of a scene; later scene edits do not affect it. |
| `episode.reset` | author, player | no | Start a new episode from the active episode's frozen starting scene. |
| `episode.observe` | author, player | no | Return the player's observation of the active episode, including legal actions. |
| `episode.act` | author, player | no | Submit one action and advance exactly one tick. Rejected actions change nothing and explain why. |
| `episode.events` | author, player | no | Return the most recent events of the active episode, optionally only after a tick. |
| `episode.assert` | author, player | no | Evaluate assertions (outcome, position, keys, tick bound, event occurrence) against the active episode. |
| `snapshot.capture` | author | no | Capture the open project and active episode (simulation state only) in memory. |
| `snapshot.restore` | author | yes | Restore a snapshot's project and episode. The revision still increases, so writes based on older revisions stay stale. |
| `replay.export` | author, player | no | Export the active episode's replay: initial scene, accepted actions and per-tick hashes. Authors may pass a path; players write to the launcher's replay directory or receive it inline. |
| `replay.verify` | author | no | Re-execute a replay's recorded actions and compare every state hash and the outcome; optionally check it belongs to a scene of the open project. |

## Examples

### `discover`

```json
{"request_id":"example-discover","protocol_version":1,"operation":"discover","arguments":{"operation":"entity.create"}}
```

### `session.status`

```json
{"request_id":"example-session-status","protocol_version":1,"operation":"session.status","arguments":{}}
```

## Error codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `malformed_json` | The line is not valid UTF-8 JSON. |
| `invalid_envelope` | The JSON is not a valid request envelope (missing, mistyped or unknown top-level fields). |
| `unsupported_protocol_version` | protocol_version is not supported by this engine. |
| `request_too_large` | The request line exceeds the size limit. |
| `unknown_operation` | No operation has this name. |
| `invalid_arguments` | Arguments do not match the operation's schema or are inconsistent. |
| `permission_denied` | This session's role may not perform the operation. |
| `no_project_open` | The operation needs an open project. |
| `scene_not_found` | The project has no scene with this name. |
| `scene_already_exists` | A scene with this name already exists. |
| `entity_not_found` | The scene has no entity with this id. |
| `invalid_name` | Names use 1-64 characters of a-z, 0-9, '_' or '-'. |
| `invalid_layout` | The ASCII layout cannot be parsed. |
| `invalid_grid_size` | Grid width and height must be between 1 and 64. |
| `stale_revision` | expected_revision does not match the current revision; nothing was changed. |
| `out_of_bounds` | A position (or move target) lies outside the grid. |
| `cell_occupied` | The target cell already holds an entity. |
| `duplicate_player` | A scene holds at most one player. |
| `duplicate_key_color` | A scene holds at most one key per color. |
| `invalid_label` | Labels are 1-64 characters without control characters. |
| `invalid_rules` | A rule parameter is out of range. |
| `scene_not_playable` | The scene lacks the required player/control or objective entities, so no episode can start. |
| `no_active_episode` | The operation needs a started episode. |
| `episode_finished` | The episode already ended; start or reset one. |
| `stale_episode` | expected_episode_id is not the active episode; the action was not applied. |
| `stale_tick` | expected_tick does not match the episode's tick; the action was not applied. |
| `move_blocked` | A wall occupies the move target. |
| `door_locked` | The move target is a door whose key the player does not hold. |
| `snapshot_not_found` | No snapshot has this id in this session. |
| `limit_exceeded` | A documented limit (batch size, snapshot count, ...) would be exceeded. |
| `storage_error` | A file could not be read or written. |
| `invalid_project_file` | The project file is malformed or violates scene invariants. |
| `invalid_replay` | The replay file is malformed or its scene is invalid. |
| `incompatible_version` | A file uses a format or hash version this engine does not support. |
| `internal_error` | Engine bug. State changes commit only after a handler completes, so the request had no effect. |
